items.title: Buddy DeFranco interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: John Coltrane, Chick Corea and today Cecil Taylor I think.

ctx.x: Because we know there’s only two of them now. There was Parker and Tatum, right?

Well I think there might have been more, and you know, Peterson, Oscar Peterson is in that area, John Coltrane, Chick Corea and today Cecil Taylor I think. Cecil Taylor is probably the ultimate jazz creator today, the ultimate in modern jazz, modern jazz. Not commercial I don’t think.
No. I wouldn’t book him for a dance. But this must have been a fun record to make.

items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: I think a lot of them, like you, maybe kind of migrated there, right? Is that right? The Heath brothers and Coltrane, they weren’t actually born there, but they.
Coltrane, Dizzy, yep. Who am I thinking of now? That’s terrible. My memory is not what it used to be. But Benny Golson and uh…
